description: Transforms one raw SARIF-result record shipped by errow-shipper (CONTRACT s15: SARIF result keys at top level + rule + @timestamp/stream/run/source/doc_id) into the normalized Vendetta alert of CONTRACT s4.1 so Errow findings land in vendetta-alerts-* next to Wazuh alerts. Calls errow-finding-enrichment first (cwe, owasp, mitre). id = doc_id, else a SHA-256 fingerprint of run+ruleId+primaryLocationLineHash+finding id+endpoint. rule.level: critical 14, high 11, medium 8, low 5, info 2. severity = properties.errow.severity, else SARIF level (error=high, warning=medium, note=low, default warning). The raw SARIF keys are dropped from the alert (no PoC/analysis bodies, full_log is a one-line summary). ai.*, root_cause and recommended_action are never emitted so a later AI enrichment upsert is not clobbered. Use with update+doc_as_upsert or index (_id is set to the alert id). On failure the record is kept and ingest_error is set.

set.description: Use the Errow finding timestamp when the shipper did not stamp the record.
set.if: ctx.properties instanceof Map && ctx.properties.errow instanceof Map && ctx.properties.errow.timestamp != null

pipeline.description: CWE -> OWASP Top 10:2021, MITRE ATT&CK, normalised severity.
pipeline.name: errow-finding-enrichment

fingerprint.description: Alert id when the shipper did not provide doc_id.

script.description: Build the s4.1 alert atomically, then replace the raw SARIF keys with it.
Keep the record indexable in vendetta-alerts-*: the raw shipper field `source` (string) would clash with the alert's source object.
